auth.summary: Authentication cubits for sign-in, sign-up, and OTP verification.
auth.notes: Auth cubits are not registered via GetIt; they are created inline via BlocProvider in each presentation page. injectionModule points to where AppSessionRepository is wired.

history.summary: Read-only view of past workout and nutrition history with edit/delete.
history.notes: Read-only consumer of log's data; shares repository singletons.

home.summary: Dashboard surface aggregating muscle visual state and nutrition summary.
home.notes: HomeBloc is registered directly in injection_container.dart (no dedicated module file). MuscleVisualBloc is in register_muscle_stimulus_module.dart. LoadHomeDashboardData is a feature-local use case wrapper under lib/features/home/application/usecases/.

library.summary: Exercise and meal catalog management (browse, create, edit, delete).
library.notes: ExerciseBloc uses get_muscle_factors_for_exercise (from muscle_factors use cases) for muscle-group display in the catalog.

log.summary: Workout set logging and nutrition logging for the current day.
log.notes: WorkoutBloc also consumes calculate_muscle_stimulus (from the muscle_stimulus domain layer) to compute stimulation scores on each rep-set log. WorkoutBloc also exposes ExerciseInsight (PR / fatigue chips / sets-today) via SelectExerciseForInsightEvent + ClearExerciseInsightEvent; insight is recomputed in _loadWeeklySetsData after every successful add so the Exercise tab refreshes the same frame the feed updates. GetExercisePersonalRecord returns the heaviest WorkoutSet for an exercise (tie-break higher reps); fatigue chips derive from GetMuscleVisualData(TimePeriod.week) via MuscleGroups.granularToSimple. A shared MacroLabel widget (lib/features/log/presentation/widgets/shared/macro_label.dart) centralises the macro swatch+caption element (MacroKind enum bundles each macro's label and LiftColors token) — used by LogTodaySoFarCard, LogMealTab's this-entry preview, and LogMacrosTab's row headers.

profile.summary: User profile view and sign-out; manages authenticated-user metadata.
profile.notes: Remote-only repository (Supabase). No local SQLite tables. ProfileCubit also consumes AppSessionRepository and AuthSessionService via the injection module.

settings.summary: App settings surface (units, week start day, theme preferences).
settings.notes: AppSettingsCubit is registered as lazySingleton (intentional waiver — reason: app-wide settings state read by multiple pages; a factory would let instances diverge — see register_settings_module.dart:11 and KNOWN_ISSUES.md #blocs-must-be-factories-repositories-singletons). AppSettingsRepository now exposes Stream<AppSettings> watchSettings() with behavior-subject semantics (replay-last-value on subscribe, re-emit after each successful save).
